section.title: Bug History
section.para: Bug history is a feature where MantisBT tracks all modifications that are made to bugs. These include everything starting from its creation, till it is closed. For each change, the bug history will record the time stamp, user who made the change, field that changed, old value, and new value.
Independent of the these settings, MantisBT will always track the changes to a bug and add them to its history.

listitem.para: Make the bug history visible by default. If this option is not enabled, then the user will have to click on the Bug History link to see the bug history. Default is ON.
Show bug history entries in ascending or descending order. Default value is 'ASC'.

section.para: In this context, MantisBT records individual changes to text fields (Description, Steps to Reproduce, Additional Information as well as Bug Notes). These revisions are controlled by the following settings.

listitem.para: Access level required to view bug history revisions. Defaults to DEVELOPER.

note.para: Users can always see revisions for the issues and bugnotes they reported.

listitem.para: Access level required to drop bug history revisions. Defaults to MANAGER.

Threshold at which a user can edit the text of an issue he/she reported: the description, the steps to reproduce and the additional information, and nothing else of the issue. It never applies to issues reported by somebody else, and not to issues that are read-only. The default value is equal to the configuration setting $g_update_bug_threshold, so nobody gets a new right unless it is lowered, for example to REPORTER.

Every edit keeps the previous text as a revision, so $g_bug_revision_view_threshold decides who can read the original. The issue page tells everybody who can see the text that it was edited, and when. Notes are edited with $g_bugnote_user_edit_threshold, which MantisBT has and which also shows "Last edited" on the note.
